description: Agency setup on Google Ads: the manager (MCC) and client account tree, and the links between them. action hierarchy (default) shows each shared account's clients and managers with link status and managerLinkId, pending invitations included. invite: managerCustomerId sends clientCustomerId an invitation (PENDING until the client accepts). accept / decline: answer an invitation as the client. cancel: withdraw a pending invitation, as the manager. unlink: end an active link, as the manager. accept and unlink change who controls the account, so they need confirm:true after the user agrees; validateOnly:true has Google check any write first. Read back from Google. Free.

action.description: hierarchy (default), invite, accept, decline, cancel or unlink

confirm.description: true after the user agreed (accept, unlink)

customerId.description: hierarchy: only the tree of this shared account; omit for every shared account

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

managerLinkId.description: from action hierarchy (accept, decline, cancel, unlink)

validateOnly.description: true = Google checks it, nothing changes

name: manage_google_ads_manager_links
title: Google Ads manager (MCC) links
